answers.answer: The abstract must be no more than 250 words.
answers.quote: An abstract of no more than 250 words is required.

answers.answer: The Instructions do not specify a maximum number of words allowed in a figure legend.
The publication fee for a Note is 40,000 JPY plus tax.
answers.quote: The publication fee for an accepted manuscript in any category except “Commentary and Perspective” or “Editorial” is 40,000 JPY plus tax for the authors.

answers.answer: The Instructions do not specify a maximum number of references allowed in a Regular Article.
A revised manuscript must be returned within 90 days of receiving the editorial decision.
answers.quote: Authors who have been requested to revise their manuscript should send the revised version to the handling editor within 90 days of receiving the editorial decision.

answers.answer: The Instructions do not specify a required font size for the body text.
A manuscript is sent to two or more reviewers.
answers.quote: Manuscripts are sent out for peer review to two or more reviewers.

answers.answer: The Instructions do not specify a maximum number of authors permitted on a Regular Article.
